visual.title: The statistic has its own distribution
visual.caption: Each bar counts the mean of one sample. The population is fixed, yet the means spread less as the sample grows, which is why a statistic needs its own distribution.

predict.question: As the sample size grows, the sampling distribution of the mean:
predict.explain: The standard error is σ/√n, so the histogram narrows as n grows. The dashed normal curve uses exactly that spread.
